# Ledger9 Compact ZKIR v3 release artifacts

These fixtures were generated with the release-compatible Ledger9 branch
`sync/ledger9-current` at `3fd8a891`, which locks betsudo proofs 0.8.2 at
`397b2424`, registry stdlib 2.4.0, and registry ZKIR 3.2.1. The source is
`../../compact-v3-counter/increment.zkir` (SHA-256
`6b894828e34f757fec5df0e5872a5fbede9c7cb8fa2fbbb20c7e827717914670`),
generated by Compact 0.36.1.

The ignored `export_release_082_compact_v3_artifacts` test in the release
generator branch at `7a10c7a0` produced these tagged bytes. It uses a
synthetic KZG setup with ChaCha20 seed `[7; 32]`, a proof RNG seed `[42; 32]`,
binding input 42, communication opening 7, and the generated circuit's public
transcript. It verifies the proof under the release verifier key before
writing the artifacts. The setup is for compatibility testing only.

| Artifact | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `prover-key-082.bin` | 58,166 | `8fbe0692c2cc13c524489504bd8df95e15257567377f982876715074fcaa4a07` |
| `verifier-key-082.bin` | 1,353 | `61b289dd0972a9fd04bdd304f5b1475424bf036b8f8c5634cdff75103eb0e4b3` |
| `proof-082.bin` | 3,845 | `bb230824c54a7a1f1acd651fd5952ec431427a56093531e92a8bf85bec833ce3` |

The candidate test checks these artifacts at the Ledger ZKIR v3 boundary.
The released prover-key outer tag deserializes, but 0.8.3 initialization
rejects its inner PCS identifier. The released verifier-key outer tag also
deserializes, but its inner read fails during verification. The proof wrapper
deserializes but does not verify under a new 0.8.3 key. This is a deliberate
format compatibility gate, not a measurement of proving speed or memory.
Any future migration that accepts released keys or proofs must define an
explicit conversion or versioned read path and add a positive verification
fixture before changing this rejection expectation.
